assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE opaque SQUARE1254x1254 or at least1024x1024 high-resolution game background, stage5 region1 DEEP LUNAR TUNNEL. Use the attached previous stage's cave as concept/style reference; freshly paint a deeper continuation, not an enlarged copy. Direct overhead terrain, broad open central passage running vertically, darker jagged compact lunar rock walls on both sides, fine fractured grey-brown regolith floor, old structural steel ribs partly buried in rock, conduits and tiny dim amber utility lamps in wall recesses. Increasing depth and denser engineered supports than reference. Floor stays neutral desaturated charcoal/grey so weathered gunmetal retractable defense hatches can blend into it; keep broad central play area unobstructed. High-detail realistic remastered shooter game art, subdued contrast. Tile must continue top-to-bottom for vertical scrolling; no top/bottom wall closing the corridor. No fixed turrets or computer boss baked into background, no viewpoint vanishing point, characters, ships, words, UI, frame or vignette. Single square scene.

Use case: stylized-concept. ONE high-resolution opaque SQUARE1254x1254 or at least1024x1024 background for vertical scrolling shooter stage5 region2 METAL ACCESS TUNNEL leading to a secret supercomputer chamber. Reference previous region is deep lunar rock and dark steel. Create a fresh engineered continuation: directly overhead view of a wide dark desaturated gunmetal floor made of large worn interlocking rectangular armor plates, recessed seams, small maintenance bolts, fine scratches and dust. Vertical parallel cable conduits, heavy structural ribs and service panels line LEFT and RIGHT sides, a few small amber guide lamps and very restrained dull cyan indicators. Keep the central70percent broad and mostly flat to blend retractable grey defense hatches. Realistic detailed remastered game art, same industrial scale/lighting and grey-brown graphite palette as reference, with rock almost entirely replaced by metal. Top/bottom continue smoothly for repeated vertical scrolling, no top/bottom walls or vanishing point. No turrets, boss/computer body baked into floor, no typography, UI, grid overlays, borders or vignette. One square terrain scene.

Use case: stylized-concept. ONE native high-resolution opaque SQUARE1254x1254 or at least1024x1024 game background, stage5 region3 SECRET SUPERCOMPUTER CHAMBER, matching attached industrial metal tunnel material and viewpoint. Direct overhead view of a much wider hidden high-tech room: detailed graphite floor panels and recessed cable channels in the broad central area, tall dense server racks, cooling assemblies, power distribution housings and conduits tightly lining LEFT and RIGHT sides, a little discreet cyan status illumination mixed with dim amber utilities. Keep center and upper-center floor mostly unobstructed because a separate large floor-mounted supercomputer boss sprite will be placed there at runtime; do NOT bake a central computer, pedestal, boss or turret into the image. The room feels secret, industrial and massive, realistic textured remastered shooter art, subdued neutral weathered steel palette matching reference, not glossy futuristic white. Top/bottom continue server aisles and floor for vertical scrolling; no vanishing point or enclosing horizontal wall. No text, HUD, ships, people, labels, grids, borders or strong vignette. One full square scene.

Use case: stylized-concept. ONE isolated game sprite on a genuinely TRANSPARENT background: a CLOSED retractable defense-turret FLOOR HATCH, directly overhead orthographic view, centered and perfectly symmetric. Use attached industrial tunnel only as material/palette reference; do not include the tunnel floor or any rectangular background patch. A low flat octagonal weathered dark gunmetal mounting collar with two interlocking sliding armored lid halves, a straight VERTICAL center seam, subtle bolts and seams. Quiet desaturated graphite and dusty brown-grey patina matching the tunnel plates, barely visible tiny amber status pin, no glowing ring. Hatch should blend into grey rock or metal flooring when placed over it. Entire collar and both closed door halves in one centered square transparent PNG, with about15percent transparent margin. Native1024x1024 or larger; finely painted realistic remastered shooter sprite, crisp readable silhouette at64px runtime size, limited busy detail. No weapon, no text, no labels, no floor square, no shadow outside collar, no checkerboard baked into image, no perspective slant.

A fictional sci-fi arcade videogame enemy sprite, isolated on transparent background. Direct overhead view of a compact floor-mounted mechanical sentry with a chunky circular grey armored body and two simple stylized forward projections pointing toward the bottom of the image. Retro remastered shooter art, painted mechanical shapes with subtle worn dark grey/brown metal and a tiny amber indicator, matching the attached hatch's visual palette. Clearly a small imaginary game object, no realistic engineering diagram or technical details. Entire silhouette centered with generous transparent margin, no wings, no aircraft engines, no floor or base platform because that is drawn separately. No lettering, flashes, bullets, people, shadows outside the object, labels, grid or checkerboard. One sprite for the autocannon-class enemy in a top-down space arcade game.

One fictional sci-fi arcade videogame ENERGYPULSE floor-sentry sprite on genuine transparent background, direct overhead orthographic view. Use attached mechanical sentry only as palette/material family reference. Distinct silhouette: compact weathered dark graphite circular housing, one broad short downward-facing emitter with a recessed cool cyan lens and two small side capacitor blocks. Looks like a fictional energy device rather than a normal gun. Subtle grey/brown dust and metal edge highlights, small blue indicator, no excessive glow. Painterly detailed remastered top-down shooter enemy, readable at55px size. Centered entire object with transparent margin, no terrain patch, floor hatch, separate pedestal, wings, engines, lettering, diagrams, projectiles, muzzle flash, people, shadows outside object or baked checkerboard. One fully exposed assembly, deployment is animated by engine.

Use case: stylized-concept. Game sprite generation, transparent background. Input reference image is the game's existing boss atlas: upper row bosses 2,3,4 define the exact painted mechanical rendering style, line weight, faceted metallic shading and moderate detail density. Create ONE NEW boss CENTRAL BODY ONLY for a vertical arcade shooter: a floor-anchored SUPERCOMPUTER shaped as a humanoid robot UPPER TORSO with mechanical head, broad chest and waist. Front/top three-quarter projection matching the existing reference bosses, facing bottom of screen. Arm sockets on both shoulders, but NO arms, NO hands, NO wings, NO weapons attached (these are separate sprites). An imposing intelligent computer core inset in chest, charcoal machinery, off-white armor plates, muted blue-violet secondary armor, small orange and cyan status lights. Thick bundles of cables extend from waist/back and shoulders outward and downward, plugged into small flat floor connector blocks; cables visibly anchor the immobile torso to the chamber floor. No legs. Central body strong near-symmetrical silhouette. Isolated complete sprite, ample transparent margin on all sides. Match reference's illustrated painted arcade mech look: crisp dark outlines, controlled metallic highlights, simple readable large panels, lightly worn edges; avoid photorealism, ultra-detailed realistic surface noise, toy/chibi proportions, excessive deformation, bloom. No environment, floor plane, text, grid or watermark. The torso and cables must be entirely opaque where painted; background true alpha.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target is the supplied octagonal floor hatch sprite. Make its DESTROYED version. Preserve the exact same overhead perspective, OCTAGONAL outer footprint, eight straight sides and chamfered corner geometry, same scale, same footprint and framing, same dusty brown-gray metal color and thick collar. The rim is still recognizably the exact eight-sided hatch, with only localized chips and cracks, not collapsed into a circular heap. In its middle, replace intact doors with a dark blasted opening, broken bent octagonal door sections, black scorched interior, exposed cut cables, a few small bits contained mostly INSIDE the original footprint. Keep outer rim geometry and straight long edges clearly legible. NO circular ring, NO round crater, NO flame, NO smoke, NO giant scattered debris cloud. Painted arcade game floor debris sprite, moderate detail, no photographic noise. Output one isolated transparent alpha sprite with generous margin as in reference. No environment, text or watermark.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target image1 is the tall gatling arm; image2 is STYLE/JOINT reference only, the robot torso which must NOT be output or changed. Preserve image1 forearm, six-barrel gatling gun, armor palette and upright compact silhouette. ONLY replace the exposed screw-like cylindrical peg and thin top joint with a broad SMOOTH CLOSED SPHERICAL shoulder cover matching the torso's off-white and violet rounded shoulder shell. Think original hollow shoulder shell with its entire hole FILLED by a solid convex painted metal hemisphere. NO screw, bolt-head-looking central disc, stepped axle, male pin, open socket, black center or concentric deep rings at the top. A simple round domed armor cap with uninterrupted curved metal face, broad off-white upper surface and violet lower rim; its center will overlap and hide the torso shoulder hole when composited on TOP. Upper cap located at upper-right of the left-arm silhouette, connected naturally to upper-arm armor, same painted faceted metal linework as torso. Cap diameter about35percent of sprite height. Keep overall50x100 tall arm proportions, lower gun holes remain unchanged. Transparent alpha background, single complete arm only, no torso, no scene, no text. Match torso style exactly; minimally change existing design.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Image1 is the exact diagonal missile-wing EDIT TARGET. Image2 is the robot arm, reference ONLY for its large round shoulder armor. Change ONLY the lower-right hinge of image1. Completely remove the purple cylindrical RIM and plug-like inset lens; replace the WHOLE hinge housing with a unified ROUND SPHERICAL armor ball matching image2 shoulder: broad convex OFF-WHITE upper hemisphere and muted VIOLET lower hemisphere with a simple panel seam. The silhouette of joint must be a smooth ball, not a ring with a cap pushed into it. No concentric circular rim, opening, dark socket, recessed lens, screw, peg or visible axle. The sphere is integrated into the wing root and centered at the old hinge center. Its size should cover the whole old cylindrical hinge housing. Match the arm reference's painted faceted metal highlights and dark outlines. Preserve ALL OTHER wing details exactly: original diagonal upward-left tilt, pointed blade, white/violet panels, amber indicators, six missile cells in2columns3rows, wiring, dimensions and complete transparent background. Do not flatten or rotate wing. Single complete left wing sprite only, no arm/torso or scene. Opaque painted sphere, true alpha background.
